mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM borrow_record WHERE status IN ('BORROWED', 'OVERDUE')

SELECT b.id AS book_id, b.title, b.author, COUNT(r.id) AS borrow_count FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_id = b.id GROUP BY b.id, b.title, b.author ORDER BY borrow_count DESC, b.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT c.name AS category_name, COUNT(r.id) AS borrow_count FROM category c LEFT JOIN book b ON b.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN borrow_record r ON r.book_id = b.id GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY borrow_count DESC, c.id ASC

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.borrow_time) AS stat_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.borrow_time) AS stat_month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM borrow_record r WHERE r.borrow_time >= #{start} GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM r.borrow_time), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM r.borrow_time) ORDER BY stat_year ASC, stat_month ASC

SELECT r.id AS record_id, b.title AS book_title, rd.name AS reader_name, rd.reader_no, r.due_time FROM borrow_record r JOIN book b ON r.book_id = b.id JOIN reader rd ON r.reader_id = rd.id WHERE r.status IN ('BORROWED', 'OVERDUE') AND r.due_time < #{now} ORDER BY r.due_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
